ModMetaData.name: Wil's Role Modules : Agriculture
ModMetaData.author: Spaceman_Wil
ModMetaData.description: Forager, Tracker and Handler careers leading to Farmer, Hunter and Rancher, with crop, wildlife and livestock specialties. Includes colony-managed automatic hunting that never limits or rewrites player-designated hunts. Early draft: offline builds and tests do not constitute RimWorld gameplay validation.
